headline: Sensex and Nifty Rally Over 1% Ahead of RBI Policy Outcome Amid Positive Global Cues

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Anticipation of the RBI Monetary Policy Committee meeting outcome
Positive momentum from US markets as S&P 500 and Nasdaq hit record highs
Market rebound following a period of decline
Shift in investor focus toward the upcoming corporate earnings season
whatHappening: Sensex jumped 685 points while Nifty 50 closed above the 22,750 level
Brent crude oil prices are forecasted to reach $98 due to supply concerns
IT, Realty, and PSU Bank sectors lagged behind the broader market rally
Gold prices are projected to rise to $5,013 an ounce over the next year
summary: Indian markets witnessed a strong rally with the Sensex and Nifty gaining over 1% ahead of the RBI's policy decision. While global cues and earnings expectations boosted sentiment, sectors like IT and Realty saw selling pressure. Geopolitical tensions also pushed oil price forecasts higher.
